doc: Scans the global singly-linked node list headed by D_80081498 for the first node (other than a1) whose 16-bit field_1E has bit 0x200 set. When found: calls func_80044A50(node) and func_8003FFF0(node) unconditionally, then func_80040044(node) unless field_1E also has bit 0x80 set (i.e. frees/recycles the node unless it's flagged to be kept), then dispatches to func_8003FD64(a0,a1) if a1 is non-NULL, else func_8003FC64(a0), and returns that call's result. If no such node exists in the list, returns NULL.
